title: Republic Act No. 9729, Climate Change Act of 2009
evidence: Sec. 26: "This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) national newspapers of general circulation." The page header gives "106 OG No. 4, 461, (January 25, 2010); Manila Times; Philippine Star, November 10, 2009". The date 2009-11-25 is counted from the earlier newspaper publication (2009-11-10) by this session; no opened page states it. Opened https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/18615 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Text is the Supreme Court E-Library copy of the Act as enacted (the Official Gazette, Senate and House sites were blocked from the cloud address). Amended by R.A. 10174 (ph-ra-10174), which restates several of its sections; the E-Library serves no consolidated R.A. 9729, so the amended state is the two records read together. English only: the E-Library serves no Filipino text and no government English translation is needed. Filipino was looked for on the E-Library only; not found.

title: Republic Act No. 7394, Consumer Act of the Philippines, Title III Chapter VI: advertising and sales promotion (Arts. 108 to 124)
evidence: Art. 173: "This Act shall take effect thirty (30) days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette." The page header gives "88 OG No. 24, 3639 (June 15, 1992)". The date 1992-07-15 is counted from that publication date by this session; no opened page states it. Opened https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/3302 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Umbrella for misleading environmental claims; the Act has no environmental-claims provision. The brief named Arts. 110 to 112; Art. 110 is the false, deceptive or misleading advertisement rule, Art. 111 is price comparisons and Art. 112 food, drug, cosmetic, device and hazardous substance advertising, while Art. 115 (special claims: substantiate claims, use research results properly) fits a claims rule better, so the record is the whole Chapter VI, cut at 'CHAPTER VI' and 'CHAPTER VII'. Art. 50 (deceptive sales acts) is in Chapter I of Title III and is not stored. Text as enacted; later amendments, if any, were not checked. English only; no Filipino text found on the E-Library.

title: BSP Circular No. 1128, Series of 2021: Environmental and Social Risk Management Framework
citation: BSP Circular No. 1128, Series of 2021 (Monetary Board Resolution No. 1443 of 21 October 2021)
evidence: Sec. 3 of the corrected copy (OCR text of a scanned PDF): "This Circular shall take effect fifteen (15) calendar days following its publication either in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation." The circular does not state its publication date, and its date line is illegible in the scan. Fetched with plain curl on 2026-11-02 (HTTP 200, 6680329 bytes, application/pdf; a 'Mozilla/5.0' User-Agent is answered Access Denied).
notes: Reclassified from F6 to F1: the circular amends MORB Sec. 153 to require banks to integrate environmental and social risks into enterprise-wide risk management and carries a disclosure requirements paragraph; it is not a rule on claims. The only copy on bsp.gov.ph is a 13-page scanned image (6.7 MB, page images with an embedded OCR text layer) whose text layer is garbled (for example 'Sectlonl', 'Pesponsibilities of the Mrd of Dirutorc'), so no text is stored. Looked for an HTML or Word copy: the MORB site morb.bsp.gov.ph answered 500. English only.
status_note: Row PH-BSP-ADOPTED passes, but the only copy is a scanned image with garbled OCR; no text stored.
